title: After Your Two Blocks
can_do: 请求下一轮，并用明确事件确认什么时候轮到自己。
trigger: A peer is actively using the shared truck, and the child wants a turn without interrupting it.
core_response: Can I have a turn after you?
stretch_response: You carry two blocks, then it is my turn.
repair_response: Not now. I mean after your two blocks.
setting: Sharing one toy truck during block play.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: I'm using the red truck to fill this box.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Can I have a turn after you?

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: Yes, after I carry these two blocks.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Okay. You carry two blocks, then it is my turn.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: Both blocks are in. Here is the truck.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Thanks. Now I will carry the blue blocks.

replay_cards.title: Turn with the marker
replay_cards.change: The peer is finishing one sun
replay_cards.challenge: Ask for the marker after the sun, watch it finish, receive it, and draw the next item

replay_cards.title: Turn on the swing
replay_cards.change: The peer asks for three more pushes
replay_cards.challenge: Agree on the clear endpoint, count it together, switch places, and begin the child's turn

parent_support: Let the current player finish a small visible unit.
Make the handoff happen exactly when agreed so the sequence language has meaning.
